en: Black-and-white view of a small town scene with a metal road bridge and adjoining pedestrian path crossing a stony riverbank. In the background stands a rectangular two‑storey building and several wooden houses with pitched roofs. A cyclist is crossing the bridge and an early automobile is visible on the road beyond. There are telegraph poles and a simple street lamp. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
